g.text: SIM-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
[identifier does not match UI / API kind]
Use the requested userId, or actor.id() if omitted.
An unknown system or missing user throws a 404 DomainException.
The attempt skips the remaining status and decision reads.
Use empty effective permissions and allowed=false.
If the version matches, finish with SimulationResult.
A changed version on a client error retries the whole attempt.
Reason is USER_DISABLED / SYSTEM_DISABLED, ALLOW or DENY.
Include the explanation trace and effective permissions.
